entities.name: Service Teams
entities.rationale: Group-of-people icon labeled 'SERVICE TEAMS' (partially hidden behind the presenter) to the left of ECS; represents the internal teams that own the services.

entities.name: ECS
entities.rationale: Orange container icon labeled 'ECS' in the center-left of the board. Not inside any box. Has an arrow to Lambda and receives an arrow coming up from the NON-PROD box.

entities.name: Lambda (x25)
entities.rationale: Orange Lambda icon labeled 'LAMBDA' with a stacked outline behind it and 'x25' annotation, indicating about 25 Lambda functions. Receives an arrow from ECS.

entities.name: RDS PostgreSQL
entities.rationale: Blue RDS icon labeled 'RDS POSTGRESQL' at the top of the right-hand column of data/messaging services. No lines drawn to it.

entities.name: DynamoDB
entities.rationale: Blue DynamoDB icon labeled 'DYNAMODB' in the middle of the right-hand column. No lines drawn to it.

entities.name: SNS
entities.rationale: Pink SNS icon labeled 'SNS' at the bottom of the right-hand column. No lines drawn to it.

entities.name: NON-PROD
entities.rationale: Blue dashed box labeled 'NON-PROD' representing the non-production environment/account. It is an empty labeled container (no icons drawn inside). An arrow goes from it up to ECS and another from it to the PROD box.

entities.name: PROD
entities.rationale: Blue dashed box labeled 'PROD' representing the production environment/account. It is an empty labeled container (no icons drawn inside). Receives an arrow from NON-PROD.

visual_connections.description: Straight white arrow drawn from the ECS icon to the Lambda icon.
Curved white arrow starting just above the NON-PROD dashed box and ending with an arrowhead at the bottom-left of the ECS icon.
Curved white arrow leaving the bottom of the NON-PROD dashed box and ending with an arrowhead at the left side of the PROD dashed box (promotion from non-production to production).
